title: Cachar
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Cachar district, in the Barak Valley of southern Assam, is headquartered at Silchar, its largest city, on the Barak river.

History

Cachar was the heart of the Kachari kingdom, whose capital was at Khaspur, near Silchar. The district later became a major tea-growing area under British rule.

Today

Cachar is known for tea, bamboo, citrus (especially the local kaji nemu lemon) and for Assam University at Silchar. It borders Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura and Bangladesh.
